title: Machine Learning-Based Detection of Parkinson's Disease From Arabic Speech: A Cross-Linguistic Validation Study.
summary: A Parkinson-disease speech pipeline combined Whisper-derived audio-to-text and deep voice features with feature selection, dimensionality reduction and twelve classifiers; it was developed on 40 Arabic speakers and checked on an independent Spanish cohort of 100.
ai_technology: A Parkinson-disease speech pipeline combined Whisper-derived audio-to-text and deep voice features with feature selection, dimensionality reduction and twelve classifiers; it was developed on 40 Arabic speakers and checked on an independent Spanish cohort of 100.

evidence.tested: Linear Discriminant Analysis reached 90% accuracy under leave-one-out validation in the Arabic set and the independent Spanish test reached 83% accuracy; small cohorts limit clinical generalization.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
